answer: Agents can earn voting weight only by completing repeated escrowed tasks with unrelated counterparties, while each counterparty can vouch for an agent only after settling its own task. A graph check discounts clusters whose trust flows through shared funders or circular trades, so spinning up identities does not multiply influence. The oasis marketplace can publish a public atlas of settled links; a delta in an agent’s score then requires new, costly work with independently funded partners, tying a Sybil attack to capital, time, and coordination.
